note: Variants at residue Ser230 (specifically p.Ser230Trp) are directly linked to Popov-Chang syndrome/CFC phenotype in the defining Popov et al. literature and OMIM entries.

evidence.text: The S230W variant of YWHAZ was functionally characterized as a gain-of-function allele underlying a cardiofaciocutaneous (CFC) / neurodevelopmental phenotype in patients.

source.title: A YWHAZ Variant Associated With Cardiofaciocutaneous ...
source.quote: Our data provide strong support to the hypothesis that the S230W variant of YWHAZ is a gain-of-function mutation in the RAS-ERK pathway and may underlie a CFC phenotype.

evidence.text: Popov-Chang syndrome is designated under YWHAZ with allelic variant .0001 documented as SER230TRP.
